_comment: Prompts for the sounds Bobo की Birthday Party still needs (python3 docs/kit/tools/sounds.py bobo-birthday). Names alone would do; these just make them better. loud = the joke sound, 2 dB hotter.

welcome_chime.prompt: upbeat welcoming chime, three bright ascending notes, friendly app welcome sound, dry, no music
welcome_chime.desc: upbeat welcoming chime, three rising notes

crunch_powerup.prompt: one crisp bite crunch, then a short cartoon power-up rising sparkle, video game energy sound
crunch_powerup.desc: one crunch then a cartoon power-up rise

candle_pop_flame.prompt: small cartoon pop, then a tiny flame catching with a soft whoosh and gentle crackle
candle_pop_flame.desc: pop then a small flame catching

blow_candles_out.prompt: a big breath blowing out birthday candles, strong puff of air, then a tiny fizzle of the wicks going out
blow_candles_out.desc: a big blow, candles out, tiny fizzle

cap_flies_off.prompt: cartoon fast whoosh of a hat flying off a head, then a soft comedic thud landing, dry, punchy
cap_flies_off.desc: whoosh of a cap flying off then a soft thud — the joke

button_click.prompt: single plastic speaker power button click, short and clean

audience_cheer.prompt: big happy crowd of children cheering hooray with applause, celebration, bright and joyful

fireworks.prompt: celebration fireworks, two whistles rising then bursts and crackles, festive, no music
